QuestionText: On which date does India celebrate Independence Day?
Explanation: India gained independence from British rule on 15 August 1947. This day is celebrated every year as Independence Day.

QuestionText: On which date is Republic Day celebrated in India?
Explanation: Republic Day is celebrated on 26 January. On this day in 1950, India's Constitution came into force.

QuestionText: Gandhi Jayanti is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: Gandhi Jayanti marks the birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi (born 2 October 1869). It is a national holiday.

QuestionText: Children's Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: Children's Day (Bal Diwas) is celebrated on 14 November, the birthday of Jawaharlal Nehru, who loved children.

QuestionText: Teachers' Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: Teachers' Day is celebrated on 5 September, the birthday of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, India's second President.

QuestionText: On which date is Martyrs' Day (Shaheed Diwas) observed in India?
Explanation: Martyrs' Day is observed on 30 January — the day Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated in 1948.

QuestionText: National Science Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: National Science Day is celebrated on 28 February, the day Sir CV Raman announced his discovery of the Raman Effect in 1928.

QuestionText: National Doctor's Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: National Doctor's Day is celebrated on 1 July, the birthday of Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, a renowned physician and former Chief Minister of West Bengal.

QuestionText: On which date is World Environment Day celebrated?
Explanation: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5 June every year to raise awareness about protecting the environment.

QuestionText: Earth Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: Earth Day is observed on 22 April every year to demonstrate support for environmental protection.

QuestionText: On which date is World Water Day observed?
Explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March every year to highlight the importance of freshwater.

QuestionText: National Youth Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: National Youth Day is celebrated on 12 January, the birthday of Swami Vivekananda.

QuestionText: National Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) is celebrated on?
Explanation: Constitution Day is observed on 26 November, the day India's Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution in 1949.

QuestionText: International Women's Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: International Women's Day is celebrated on 8 March every year to honour women's achievements and advocate for gender equality.

QuestionText: World Health Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: World Health Day is celebrated on 7 April, the founding day of the World Health Organisation (WHO) in 1948.

QuestionText: National Voters' Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: National Voters' Day is celebrated on 25 January, the day the Election Commission of India was founded in 1950.

QuestionText: Navy Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: Navy Day is celebrated on 4 December to commemorate India's decisive naval operations during the 1971 India–Pakistan war.

QuestionText: Army Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: Army Day is celebrated on 15 January to mark the day when General K.M. Cariappa became the first Indian Commander-in-Chief in 1949.

QuestionText: Air Force Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: Air Force Day is celebrated on 8 October, the day the Indian Air Force was officially established in 1932.

QuestionText: Kargil Vijay Diwas is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: Kargil Vijay Diwas is celebrated on 26 July to mark India's victory in the Kargil War of 1999 against Pakistan.

QuestionText: World Literacy Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: World Literacy Day is celebrated on 8 September every year to promote literacy and education globally.

QuestionText: International Day of Yoga is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: International Day of Yoga is celebrated on 21 June every year since 2015. It was proposed by India's PM Narendra Modi.

QuestionText: National Girl Child Day is observed on which date?
Explanation: National Girl Child Day is observed on 24 January every year to raise awareness about gender inequality and promote girl children's rights.

QuestionText: Sardar Patel Jayanti (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas) is observed on?
Explanation: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) is observed on 31 October, the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

QuestionText: World Animal Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: World Animal Day is celebrated on 4 October — the feast day of Francis of Assisi, patron saint of animals — to raise awareness about animal welfare.

QuestionText: National Sports Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: National Sports Day is celebrated on 29 August, the birthday of hockey legend Major Dhyan Chand.

QuestionText: Polio National Immunization Day is known as?
Explanation: Pulse Polio Day is when India conducts its National Immunization Day campaign. Children under 5 are given polio drops free of cost.

QuestionText: World AIDS Day is observed on which date?
Explanation: World AIDS Day is observed on 1 December every year to raise awareness about the AIDS epidemic and support those affected.

QuestionText: National Pollution Prevention Day is observed on?
Explanation: National Pollution Prevention Day is observed on 2 December to remember those who lost their lives in the Bhopal Gas Tragedy (2–3 December 1984).

QuestionText: Anti-Terrorism Day is observed in India on which date?
Explanation: Anti-Terrorism Day is observed on 21 May, the death anniversary of former PM Rajiv Gandhi, who was assassinated by a suicide bomber in 1991.

QuestionText: World Teachers' Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: World Teachers' Day is celebrated on 5 October by UNESCO to recognise and reflect on the role of teachers worldwide.

QuestionText: International Children's Day (United Nations) is celebrated on?
Explanation: The UN celebrates Universal Children's Day on 20 November — the day the UN General Assembly adopted the Convention on the Rights of the Child (1989).

QuestionText: National Integration Day is observed on which date in India?
Explanation: National Integration Day is observed on 19 November, the birthday of Indira Gandhi, India's first woman Prime Minister.

QuestionText: World Press Freedom Day is observed on?
Explanation: World Press Freedom Day is observed on 3 May every year to evaluate press freedom worldwide and defend media from attacks on their independence.

QuestionText: International Peace Day (World Peace Day) is celebrated on?
Explanation: The International Day of Peace is observed on 21 September. The UN calls for a day of non-violence and ceasefire among all nations.

QuestionText: World Sparrow Day is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: World Sparrow Day is celebrated on 20 March to raise awareness about the decline of the house sparrow and other birds.

QuestionText: National Technology Day is celebrated in India on which date?
Explanation: National Technology Day is celebrated on 11 May — the day in 1998 when India successfully conducted the Pokhran nuclear tests (Operation Shakti).

QuestionText: Vigilance Awareness Week is observed by the CBI in India during which period?
Explanation: Vigilance Awareness Week is observed from 27 October to 2 November every year to promote integrity and transparency in public life.

QuestionText: The World Ozone Day is observed on which date?
Explanation: World Ozone Day is observed on 16 September to mark the signing of the Montreal Protocol in 1987, which aims to heal the ozone layer.

QuestionText: National Farmers Day (Kisan Diwas) is observed in India on?
Explanation: National Farmers Day is observed on 23 December, the birthday of Chaudhary Charan Singh, India's 5th Prime Minister.

QuestionText: World Habitat Day is observed on which day?
Explanation: World Habitat Day is observed on the first Monday of October every year to reflect on the state of towns and cities and the right to adequate shelter.

QuestionText: Hiroshima Day is observed on which date?
Explanation: Hiroshima Day is observed on 6 August to mark the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, Japan, by the USA in 1945. It is a day for peace advocacy.

QuestionText: National Handloom Day is observed in India on which date?
Explanation: National Handloom Day is observed on 7 August. This date commemorates the Swadeshi Movement launched on 7 August 1905.

QuestionText: Ambedkar Jayanti is celebrated on which date?
Explanation: Ambedkar Jayanti is celebrated on 14 April, the birthday of Dr. BR Ambedkar, the chief architect of India's Constitution.

QuestionText: The International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on?
Explanation: The International Day of Persons with Disabilities is observed on 3 December to promote understanding of disability issues.

QuestionText: World Tuberculosis Day is observed on?
Explanation: World TB Day is observed on 24 March — the day in 1882 when Dr. Robert Koch announced his discovery of the TB bacterium.

QuestionText: Matribhasha Diwas (International Mother Language Day) is observed on?
Explanation: International Mother Language Day is observed on 21 February, proclaimed by UNESCO in 1999 to promote multilingualism and cultural diversity.

QuestionText: Hindi Diwas (Hindi Day) is observed in India on which date?
Explanation: Hindi Diwas is observed on 14 September — the day in 1949 when Hindi was adopted as one of India's official languages.

QuestionText: National Safe Motherhood Day is observed in India on?
Explanation: National Safe Motherhood Day is observed on 11 April, the birthday of Kasturba Gandhi, to raise awareness about maternal health.

QuestionText: Rajiv Gandhi's birthday, observed as Sadbhavna Diwas (Harmony Day), falls on?
Explanation: Sadbhavna Diwas (Harmony Day) is observed on 20 August, the birthday of Rajiv Gandhi, to promote communal harmony and national integration.
